news.title: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited to Report Q4, 2026 Results on May 22, 2026
news.body: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited announced that they will report Q4, 2026 results on May 22, 2026

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 49% per year over the past 5 years. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹22m revenue, or US$231k). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹223.5m market cap, or US$2.39m). Minor Risk

news.title: Now 22% overvalued after recent price rise
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has risen 11% to ₹21.91. The fair value is estimated to be ₹17.92, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has declined by 15% over the last 3 years. Meanwhile, the company became loss making.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.26 loss per share (vs ₹0.21 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.26 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.21 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.70m (down 88% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹2.70m (loss widened 29% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 82 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
